entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's huge... I didn't realize such a gigantic[n]place existed here...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Is... this where everyone's Treasure is held?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, that should be the case.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But this ominously bizarre air about it...[n]It almost feels like a temple of sorts.[n]Although...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Look, th-there's no point freakin' out[n]now! C'mon, let's go!
